dct_title_s: Democratic People's Republic of Korea - Tropical storm on Jul 12 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001178\_3](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001178) Tropical storm during the period Jul 12 2025-Jul 13 2025 in Japan, Republic of Korea, Democratic Republic of Korea. The center of the storm was located near latitude 30.7 longitude 126.1. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
